name: Patio Cover, Sammamish
lede: Built for chilly Pacific Northwest evenings, a cedar gable-roof patio cover shelters a new deck, with Bromic heaters and ceiling fans so warmth and airflow can be tuned all year.
data: Private home – gable-roof patio cover and deck

hero.caption: Comparable Bromic installation, not this project: replace with project photography once licensed.

beats: A cedar gable-roof patio cover with skylights over a new custom deck, built by a design-build contractor.
Pacific Northwest evenings are cool and often wet; the covered deck had to be comfortable through the year.
Bromic outdoor heaters were fitted together with ceiling fans under the cedar roof. The model, count and controls are not stated.
